title: Illuminae
author: Amie Kaufman and Jay Kristoff
summary: After a mining colony is attacked, survivors flee on a fleet of ships while a plague spreads and the ship's computer starts behaving oddly. The story is told entirely through emails, transcripts, files and diagrams.
readIf: you want a fast, visually inventive teen sci-fi thriller that you can read in a weekend.
skipIf: you do not like unusual formatting or e-reader layouts, since the design is half the experience.

pairings.reason: A darker, much more extreme example of a book where layout and documents are part of the story.
Another fast young-adult-friendly science fiction story with a rebellious young hero and brutal stakes.
A lighter young adult science-fiction story with an engaging heroine and a mix of romance and plot.
